title: German Potato Crumble with Warm Irish Twist
description: A hearty, warm potato dish with the comforting flavors of Germany, infused with a hint of Irish charm.

ingredients.name: crumble
ingredients.amount: 1/2 cup, breadcrumbs mixed with 2 tbsp, grated cheddar

instructions: In a large bowl, combine sliced potatoes, melted butter, and dried thyme. Toss until potatoes are evenly coated.
Transfer potato mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
If using onion, sprinkle on top of potatoes.
In a separate bowl, mix crumble topping until well combined.
Spread crumble mixture evenly over potatoes.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until potatoes are tender and topping is golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5-10 minutes before serving.
